mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2C9 and CYP3A4) and can cause CNS effects; efavirenz may increase disulfiram levels while disulfiram may potentiate efavirenz neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor for increased disulfiram toxicity (peripheral neuropathy, psychosis) and efavirenz CNS adverse effects; consider alternative antiretroviral if feasible or dose adjustment with close clinical monitoring.
